lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, following a staggered grid-like spatial distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a discernible grid of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper and mid-lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient transition from light above to shadow below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-contrast, hook-shaped white object is attached near the dorsal midline anterior to the first dorsal fin, with a thin linear filament trailing posteriorly.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) are visible in the ventral region and surrounding the pectoral fin.
